en.bdb: Even listening to the Word of the Guru, the undeserving person attains no peace-

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਵੁਠੈ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: saavan van hareeaavale vuThai sukai ak javaahaa|

en.bdb: In the month of Savan, the whole forest becomes green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region ( Calatropis procera) and javah (a prickly plant used in medicine) go dry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਬਬੀਹੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿਪ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਓਮਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: tirapat babeehe savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh sip a(n)dhar motee omaahaa|

en.bdb: Getting rain drops in the savanti nakstr (a special formation of stars in the sky) the rain bird (Paphia) gets satisfied and if the same drop falls in the mouth of a shell, it is transformed into a pearl.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਦਲੀ ਵਣਹੁ ਕਪੂਰ ਹੋਇ ਕਲਰਿ ਕਵਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: kadhalee vanahu kapoor hoi kalar kaval na hoi samaahaa|

en.bdb: In the banana fields, the same drop becomes camphor but on alkaline earth and lotus hat drop has no impact.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਹੋਇ ਧਾਤ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਦੁਰਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: biseear muh kaalakooT hoi dhaat supaatr kupaatr dhuraahaa|

en.bdb: That drop, if it goes into the mouth of a snake, becomes deadly poison. Therefore, a thing given to a genuine and undeserving person has different effects.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਉਭੈ ਸਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun saa(n)t na aavai ubhai saahaa|

en.bdb: Likewise, those who are engrossed in the worldly delusions do not get peace even though they listen to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮਰਸੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ ਬਦਰਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piramaras manmukh badharaahee badharaahaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukh attains the pleasure fruit of the love of the Lord, but manmukh, the mind orientated one, goes on following the evil path.
Manmukh always suffers loss whereas the Gurmukh earns profit.
